name: Club Members Only – Astro-Photography Workshop
description:
*🌌 Exclusive Event for Bangalore Astronomy Club Members! 📸✨*
__Club Members Specific only Event.
__Lot of discussions.
__Practical Learning.
__Full of Fun and other activities.
*Date:*
__Sep. 26-27, 2026 (Saturday Night)
*Timings:*
__Reach Farm at: 03:00 PM on Day-1
__Leave Farm at: 10:00 AM on Day-2
*Location:*
https://maps.app.goo.gl/Pt4YdP23jHGeunMM
*Stay:*
Choose between Tenpy room (1 double bed in it) or exclusive tents option.
*What is expected:*
Meeting and Formal/Informal discussions between all members.
Stargazing & Casual Photography.
Updates on future plans.
Fun Learning.
A new Big Surprise Activity at the end of the event.
Pre-Booking with full payment is mandatory for the event.
Don’t forget to use your club member discount coupon on checkout.
As we do every season, we are once again bringing you a special, members-only astronomy experience — exclusively for our Bangalore Astronomy Club members! 🌟
This year, we are going beyond our regular open stargazing events.
🔭 This is not a traditional stargazing event.
📸 This workshop is specifically focused on ASTROPHOTOGRAPHY.
Come prepared to learn, experiment, and explore the night sky through your camera and telescope. You are welcome to bring and use your own astrophotography equipment, or you can make use of our club equipment during the session.
What makes this event special?
✨ Hands-on astrophotography learning
🔭 Understanding and using astronomy equipment
📷 Learn how to capture the night sky effectively
🌌 Explore different aspects of astronomy and space throughout the night
🧑‍🏫 Get focused guidance and plenty of personal attention
👥 Limited participation — so the session remains interactive and learning-focused
With fewer participants than our regular public events, you will have a much better opportunity to ask questions, practice, troubleshoot your setup, and learn in depth.
Whether you are just getting started with astrophotography or already have your own setup, this is a great opportunity to spend a full night learning, experimenting, and photographing the universe with fellow club members. 🌠
📅 Limited seats — Book early!
👉 Book Now.
See you under the stars! 🌌📸
